title: MV I need help with multiple endings

posts.author: daveymlly
posts.body:
so im trying to make a game and i got most of the things done. i cant figure how to do multiple endings. i have 8 endings in total, and it will go like this
character asks: 1 or 2?
if you choose 1 you get 5 endings going from that route
if u choose 2 you get 3 endings going from that route
i made variables for each ending, cuz each decision going further will represent the ending
but i cant figure how i can go from there. like i want different route for each ending. if 1 is chosen i want the characters to go to a casino and if 2 is chosen i want the characters to go to a bar. but i dont want to do it with show choices... can someone help??
(after the choices are selected, there will be more choices from time to time that lead to a specific ending.)

posts.author: KaijuuKimi
posts.body: Can't you do this by checking multiple if condition/switch?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body: One possibility is that on the town map, at the entrances to bar and casino, have the transfer events check the choice made with conditional branches and only transfer if that was chosen, and a show text "closed for renovations" if the other route was chosen

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
So when you make a choice in the game, and it defines your ending, you will need to set up variables, or switches, and how you set your events up for the endings to take place.
So you mentioned that if option 1 is chosen, they go to a casino, and if option 2 is chosen, they go to a bar.
You can instantly teleport the character to that area, or, if it's a free-roam area, make it so they can't go to the other place once a choice has been made.
But to sum it up, variables and switches.
